heading: INT. STALLED ICE CREAM TRUCK, BACK COMPARTMENT - AFTERNOON

units.text: INT. STALLED ICE CREAM TRUCK, BACK COMPARTMENT - AFTERNOON
A hot steel box lined with freezer lids.
A melting puddle on the floor.
Two stools bolted to the wall.
GRAN ODALYS, 70s, big sunglasses and a flowered housedress, sits with her purse on her lap.
RUPERT, 8, called BEANS, swings his legs and licks a cone gone soft.
Beans, I told you not to touch the dials.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: I only touched one.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: That's how trucks stop, baby.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Gran, the truck stopped before I touched it.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Don't be smart with me. Your mother is smart with me enough for the whole family.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Are we gonna melt?
units.name: BEANS

units.text: We are going to wait. Mr. Delacroix is fetching a wrench.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Mr. Delacroix drives the truck and he doesn't have a wrench?
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Mr. Delacroix has many wrenches. He has lost them.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: That's dumb.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Say that to him and you walk home.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: It's eleven miles.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Then be nice.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Gran, can I tell you something?
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Always.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: I didn't get the part in the play.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Oh, Beans. Come here.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: I'm not crying.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: I know you're not. I only want to hold something sticky.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: I got to be the tree.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: A tree is an important part.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Trees don't talk.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: That's their secret. Everyone else is too busy talking to notice who's holding the stage up.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: You're making that up.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: I'm seventy-six, baby. I'm allowed.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Okay. I'll be the best tree.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: That's my Beans.
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Gran?
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Mm?
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: Your purse is dripping.
units.name: BEANS

units.text: Lord have mercy. Who put the pistachio in my purse?
units.name: GRAN ODALYS

units.text: You did, Gran!
units.name: BEANS
